criteria.1: Seven combined derived routes preserve every explicit reference, quantity, integer price, material identity, binding/access constraint and canonical provenance.
criteria.2: Explicit zero inputs remain present; missing purchase/sellback/repair data, unknown namespaces/references, malformed quantities and unsupported routes reject candidate creation.
criteria.3: Excess/fractional/per-output salvage, rare/progression/bound returns and starter currency/material/commission export reject; every rejection leaves prior candidate records/routes unchanged.

not_run: Live vendor/craft/salvage transactions, wallet/persistence and multiplayer gameplay: outside T06 scope and absent implementations.
Loop certification and real startup active-selection publication: T07 and T08.
Rendered browser interaction: no UI change; generated content/link/status checks are performed.
approved_contract_extension: User approved explicit item/material identity, salvage eligibility and starter provenance fields. Fields remain optional for legacy catalogs; economic admission requires them. Package version advances to 2.2.1-design; no existing IDs or serialized values change.

review_checklist.scope_and_correctness: Passed: canonical fields approved; implementation limited to inert economic input staging and required fixture/tooling/docs.
review_checklist.single_owner: Passed: existing Admission stages collections; EconomicInputs owns economic derivation/constraints; canonical registry remains sole editable contract source.
review_checklist.gdscript_and_godot: Passed: typed boundary/collaborator, validated dynamic record inputs, deep-copy snapshots, pinned engine import/script/runtime checks, no warning suppression/reflection/casts.
review_checklist.maintainability: Passed: one focused 279-line economic collaborator; recipe/salvage methods each own one route derivation with direct validation. No new manager, autoload, framework or mutable active store.
review_checklist.networking_security: N/A: no RPC/session/transport changes or client-authored outcomes; headless static admission execution only.
review_checklist.scenes_lifecycle: N/A: no scene/resource wiring or async lifecycle changes; new GDScript UIDs retained and project import succeeds.
review_checklist.runtime_gameplay: Not run: live vendors/crafting/salvage, durable transactions and multi-peer tests are outside T06 and absent implementations.
review_checklist.delivery: Task branches based on current fetched main in both repositories; task-scoped diffs reviewed; PR URLs and final source identities recorded after publication.

schema_provenance_note: Final canonical snapshot is extracted after final roadmap/inventory generation. Earlier executed suites retain their original source/input hashes; final runs validate the committed extraction and approved 2.2.1 contract. No generated roadmap HTML or schema bundle was edited directly.
log_retention: Diagnostic/content lines retained; extra terminal LF bytes normalized with reversible counts and original/retained SHA-256 in log-normalization.json.
